scripts.build: npm run build:library && npm run build --workspace @underglass/playground
scripts.build:library: npm run build --workspace @underglass/core && npm run build --workspace @underglass/react && npm run build --workspace @underglass/vue
scripts.dev:showcase: npm run build:library && npm run dev --workspace @underglass/showcase
scripts.build:showcase: npm run build:library && npm run build --workspace @underglass/showcase
scripts.prepack: node -e "throw new Error('Tooling root is not the release package; use npm run pack:library')"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run build && node scripts/test-browser.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vue/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/playground/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/showcase/tsconfig.json --noEmit
